description: Use for a past day's record, by date: the Full Read and the five market areas with their state words (Adverse, Cautionary, Neutral, Constructive or Supportive) as stored that day, and for the latest stored day the Brief's headline. Choose it to look up what the read was on a given day; for today use get_bitcoin_today, for the areas' 26 components get_market_detail, for the Score get_score_for_day. The stored reads begin in October 2026, so free answers start in early January 2027. Free through the Delayed date (the free cut-off, three months before the latest published day). A later date, or live = true for the latest day with its headline, costs $0.25 in bitcoin over Lightning, one payment per answer, no subscription: the first call returns an invoice instead of data (steps under payment).

date.description: A past day, YYYY-MM-DD; the stored reads begin in early October 2026 and an earlier day says where they begin. Default: the Delayed date, or the latest day with live = true. A day after the Delayed date is paid ($0.25).

live.description: true: data through the latest published day, paid ($0.25). Omit or false: the free answer, through the Delayed date.

payment.description: Omit on the first call: a paid request then returns a Lightning invoice (valid 10 minutes) and a macaroon instead of data. Pay it, then repeat the call with the same other arguments and payment = "<macaroon>:<preimage>" (the preimage your wallet shows once paid) within 24 hours. A used, expired or mismatched proof is refused with the reason; call again without payment for a new invoice.

name: get_read_for_day

as_of.description: UTC: the last day the answer covers (YYYY-MM-DD), or for the Brief and methodology the time it was published (ISO 8601)

delayed_through.description: The Delayed date: free answers stop here
